translationRepairs: I heard the Master say, "Heaven's Way is called round; earth's Way is called square," as I learned from the Master.'"
I once heard from the Master: "Heaven's Way is called round; earth's Way is called square."'"
參嘗聞諸夫子曰 contains one report by Zengzi: he once heard the Master say the quoted words. The existing ending repeats that report and drops the force of 嘗.
in surveying carriage routes' longitude and latitude, the vault's calendar and the dome's chart.
in surveying the maps' longitude and latitude, he traversed every corner of the realm.

The proposal correctly rejects the astronomical reading, but its replacement still overreads the corrupted glyphs. A printed witness gives 偏歷幅隅, 'traversed every corner of the realm,' matching the terrestrial map context.
Wakhan lies thirteen degrees fifty-one minutes west of the capital;
Wokesi lies thirteen degrees fifty-one minutes west of the capital;
The focus text is 沃克什, identical to the place rendered Wokesi in the latitude list. Wakhan would require a different Chinese transcription.
Wakhan, west of the capital by thirteen degrees fifty-one minutes;
Wokesi, west of the capital by thirteen degrees fifty-one minutes;
The literal field must use the same Wokesi rendering for the repeated Chinese place-name 沃克什.
The above were additions of the Qianlong Board of Astronomy.
Above: Qianlong-era additions to the Shixian Calendar.
The same note at s0266 is correctly translated as Qianlong-era additions to the Shixian Calendar. 時憲 is not an astronomy board here.
Right: additions under the Qianlong Directorate of Astronomy.
The above were additions to the Shixian Calendar during the Qianlong reign.
This sentence repeats s0266 verbatim, so its literal translation should repeat the established Shixian Calendar sense rather than invent a directorate.
